links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of Vent.io versus intensivist gestalt for predicting intubation within 24 hours
links.effect: Sensitivity 0.190 (physicians) vs 0.714 (Vent.io); specificity 0.960 vs 0.673. Vent.io OR 18.68 for correct when intubation needed; physicians OR 24.80 for correct when not needed.
links.quote: Vent.io had significantly greater odds of being correct when patients required intubation compared to physicians (OR 18.68; 95% CI 1.87-186.31; p=0.013).

screen.reason: Prospective observational study comparing intensive care physicians' gestalt predictions against a machine learning model (Vent.io) for predicting intubation without deploying the tool or testing a deployment safeguard.
